definitions.gloss: customer service, serving customers, attending to guests
definitions.explanation: The act of serving, attending to, or interacting with customers or guests in a business setting such as a shop, restaurant, or hotel.

notes:
USAGE:
A key concept in the Japanese service industry, where {接客|せっきゃく} standards are famously high. Often used as a modifier: {接客|せっきゃく} + noun. Can also be used as a suru verb: {接客|せっきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to serve a customer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接客|せっきゃく}⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: service attitude
- {接客|せっきゃく}⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧: customer service etiquette
- {接客|せっきゃく}{業|ぎょう}: service industry, hospitality work
- {接客|せっきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to serve customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: service (loanword, broader meaning)
- ⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧: entertaining, hosting (often business clients, more formal)
- ⟦{応対|おうたい}→応対：04110_outai⟧: receiving, dealing with (visitors, callers)
